objections.claim: Multi-region active-active database replication incurs unsustainable inter-region egress costs and idle compute fees at launch scale.
objections.failure_scenario: Replicating millions of immutable audit entries and task history across multiple GCP regions generates excessive egress and Cloud Spanner fees.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Adopt single-region regional HA Cloud SQL with Cloud Storage WAL archiving and Cloud CDN / Cloud Load Balancing for global request routing.

objections.claim: Over-provisioning Cloud Run CPU always-allocated increases baseline idle compute spend during low-activity off-peak windows.
objections.failure_scenario: Paying for persistent CPU allocation 24/7 when request rates fluctuate across time zones drains budget.
objections.recommended_mitigation: Configure request-scoped CPU allocation with modest concurrency (80 requests/container) so compute costs track active requests.
